name: The Convenient Rest
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Late industrial rest ward with a quiet invested canopy above an empty bed, a separate factory shift desk and an unlit bedside lamp, folded work clothes suggesting an exhausted shift, small textile examination tray, no sleeping worker controlled by puppet strings. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: La difesa dai disturbi non sostituisce il sonno biologico. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità.
